registryEntry.label: Conditional Access - Require MFA for All Users (Break-Glass Excluded)
registryEntry.get_command: (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri 'https://graph.microsoft.us/v1.0/identity/conditionalAccess/policies').value | Where-Object { $_.displayName -eq 'CMMC-Require-MFA-All-Users' -or ($_.state -eq 'enabled' -and $_.conditions.users.includeUsers -contains 'All' -and $_.conditions.applications.includeApplications -contains 'All' -and ((@($_.conditions.platforms.includePlatforms | Where-Object { $_ }).Count -eq 0) -or (@($_.conditions.platforms.includePlatforms) -contains 'all')) -and ((@($_.conditions.locations.includeLocations | Where-Object { $_ }).Count -eq 0) -or (@($_.conditions.locations.includeLocations) -contains 'All')) -and (@($_.conditions.signInRiskLevels | Where-Object { $_ }).Count -eq 0) -and (@($_.conditions.userRiskLevels | Where-Object { $_ }).Count -eq 0) -and ($_.grantControls.builtInControls -contains 'mfa' -or $_.grantControls.authenticationStrength)) } | Sort-Object { $_.displayName -ne 'CMMC-Require-MFA-All-Users' } | Select-Object -First 1 | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10
